subject: pharmacology
title: Opioid analgesics, receptors and dependence

steps.tx: **Opioid receptors** (mu, kappa, delta; Gi coupled closing calcium) divide labour: **mu-1** analgesia with euphoria, **mu-2** respiratory depression with constipation and miosis, kappa spinal analgesia with dysphoria, delta mood. Full agonists (morphine, fentanyl) ceiling only by toxicity; **naloxone** (short pure antagonist) reverses while **naltrexone** maintains abstinence. Pinpoint pupils with slow breathing diagnose overdose; tolerance spares constipation (never abates).
steps.say: Mu-1 kills pain, mu-2 slows breath and stalls gut. Pinpoint slow breath is opioid: naloxone short.

vis.alt: Mu-1 gives analgesia and euphoria; mu-2 gives respiratory depression, constipation and miosis. Kappa gives spinal analgesia with dysphoria; delta modulates mood. Naloxone is a short pure antagonist for overdose; naltrexone maintains abstinence.
vis.caption: Mu-1 kills pain, mu-2 slows breath and stalls gut.

steps.tx: **Agents** specialise: **morphine** (gold standard, active M6G accumulating in renal failure, histamine itch), **pethidine** (normeperidine seizures, avoided obstetrics and kidneys), **fentanyl** (lipophilic patches for stable chronic pain, chest rigidity IV, lollipops paediatric), **tramadol** (SNRI plus weak mu, seizures with SSRI, safer constipation), **methadone** (long QT with torsades, tissue stores, de-addiction supervised), codeine (CYP2D6 ultra rapid metabolisers poison breastfed babies). Renal failure prefers fentanyl or alfentanil.
steps.say: Kidneys failing in pain prefer fentanyl. Pethidine seizes kidneys: avoid. Codeine kills ultra rapid babies.

steps.tx: **Buprenorphine** (partial mu agonist, ceiling on respiratory depression, **precipitated withdrawal** if given too early in dependence) maintains opioid use disorder sublingually with naloxone combo deterring injection; **naloxone** infusion (short half life, repeat boluses with watch for re-narcotisation) reverses acute overdose. **Methylnaltrexone** (peripheral antagonist crossing neither brain nor relief) treats opioid constipation; loperamide (peripheral mu) diarrhoeas without central effects. Clonidine bridges withdrawal autonomics.
steps.say: Too early buprenorphine precipitates withdrawal; timed it maintains. Naloxone wears off first: watch re-narcotisation.

steps.tx: **WHO analgesic ladder** (nonopioid, weak opioid, strong opioid by pain with adjuvants at every rung) with **equianalgesic caution** (incomplete cross tolerance, cut calculated dose) governs prescribing; **tolerance** (needing more), **dependence** (withdrawal without), **addiction** (compulsive use despite harm) differ medicolegally. Constipation prophylaxis (laxatives from day one), antiemetics briefly, driving and storage counselling complete safe starts. De-addiction pairs OST with psychosocial care.
steps.say: Laxatives start day one with opioids. Tolerance needs more; dependence withdraws; addiction compulses.
